content.text:
The challenge is a browser-driven RFQ-to-bid task. The RFQ agent has no imports from the older extraction, RAG, Typesense, API-server, matching-demo, or worker-simulation modules, so those can be removed along with their dependencies and tests.

I’ll preserve the RFQ implementation and the other agent’s modified files. That includes `config.py`, which is unused by the RFQ agent but currently has edits in progress. [Challenge requirements](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/challenges/rfq.md)

input.input:
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"sed -n '1,100p' src/hackathon_toolkit/config.py
sed -n '1,100p' tests/test_rfq_package.py
sed -n '1,85p' tests/test_rfq_browser_smoke.py
sed -n '1,70p' tests/test_config_schema.py
rg -n 'import |from ' src/hackathon_toolkit/rfq
 git status --short",max_output_tokens:5000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
root = Path('.')
paths = [p for p in Path('src/hackathon_toolkit').glob('*.py') if p.name not in {'__init__.py', 'config.py'}]
paths += [p for p in Path('tests').glob('test_*.py') if not p.name.startswith('test_rfq_')]
paths += [Path(p) for p in subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', 'examples'], text=True).splitlines()]
paths += [Path(p) for p in ['HACKATHON_QUICKSTART.md', 'LIBRARY_USAGE.md', 'LIBRARY_AUDIT.md', 'docker-compose.yml']]
for p in paths:
    if subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', 'HEAD', '--', str(p)]):
        raise SystemExit(f'Refusing to remove modified file: {p}')
for p in paths:
    p.unlink()
print(f'Removed {len(paths)} unchanged legacy files')
Path('src/hackathon_toolkit/__init__.py').write_text('"""Model-directed browser agent for the Atira RFQ challenge."""\n\n__version__ = "0.1.0"\n')
p = Path('pyproject.toml')
s = p.read_text().replace('Composable document intelligence and asynchronous challenge workflows', 'Model-directed browser agent for the Atira RFQ-to-bid challenge')
a = s.index('[project.optional-dependencies]')
b = s.index('[project.scripts]')
s = s[:a] + '''[project.optional-dependencies]
rfq = ["httpx>=0.27", "playwright>=1.49", "pymupdf>=1.24", "jsonschema>=4.23"]
test = ["pytest>=8", "pytest-asyncio>=0.23", "hatchling", "editables", "pip"]

''' + s[b:]
s = s.replace('hackkit = "hackathon_toolkit.cli:main"\n', '')
s = s.replace('packages = ["src/hackathon_toolkit"]', 'packages = ["src/hackathon_toolkit"]\nexclude = ["src/hackathon_toolkit/config.py"]')
p.write_text(s)
p = Path('scripts/package_rfq.py')
s = p.read_text().replace('selected.extend(sorted((root / "src").rglob("*.py")))', 'selected.append(root / "src/hackathon_toolkit/__init__.py")\n    selected.extend(sorted((root / "src/hackathon_toolkit/rfq").rglob("*.py")))')
p.write_text(s)
Path('README.md').write_text('''# Atira RFQ challenge agent

A model-directed browser agent that reads tender documents, resolves current
specifications, checks ERP prices and stock, finds authorized discounts in mail,
and prepares and submits a signed bid through the tender portal.

## Install and test

Requires Python 3.11+.

```bash
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e '.[test,rfq]'
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q
.venv/bin/python -m hackathon_toolkit.rfq.runtime --help
.venv/bin/python scripts/package_rfq.py
```

The last command creates `dist/rfq-agent.tar.gz`. The sandbox manifest installs
pinned dependencies from `requirements-rfq.txt`. Installation does not require
local model weights, a search service, or an API server.

See [the RFQ agent guide](docs/RFQ_AGENT.md) for local scouting, browser setup,
runtime configuration, evidence handling, pricing rules and limitations.
The runtime reads configuration from environment variables; `.env.example`
contains local proxy defaults, and is not loaded automatically.

## Code

- `src/hackathon_toolkit/rfq/runtime.py`: model-directed tool loop and submission validation.
- `rfq/browser.py`: provided-browser interaction and document reading.
- `rfq/clef.py`: hosted Clef decisions.
- `rfq/evidence.py`: observations and citations.
- `rfq/models.py`, `rfq/resolution.py`, `rfq/pricing.py`: validated facts, business rules and Decimal pricing.
- `tests/test_rfq_*.py`: RFQ regression tests, including an opt-in browser smoke test.
- `scripts/package_rfq.py`: submission archive containing only RFQ source and required metadata.

The speculative general-purpose document toolkit, its demos and its optional
integrations have been removed. The package name remains `hackathon_toolkit`
so existing RFQ commands and the submission manifest continue to work.
`config.py` is temporarily retained because it has concurrent edits; the RFQ
runtime does not import it, and it is excluded from wheels and submission archives.

## Challenge documentation

- [Agent documentation index](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/llms.txt)
- [Getting started](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/start)
- [RFQ rules and answer format](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/challenges/rfq.md)
''')

''')
PY

content.text: The cleanup removed 44 legacy files and their dependency extras. All 85 remaining tests pass; the opt-in browser smoke test was skipped. The wheel also builds successfully. I’m checking the archive contents now to confirm unused modules are excluded from the submission.

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:".venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import tarfile
import tempfile
import zipfile
root = Path.cwd()
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('package_rfq', root / 'scripts/package_rfq.py')
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    archive = module.build(root, Path(tmp) / 'rfq-agent.tar.gz')
    with tarfile.open(archive) as tar:
        names = tar.getnames()
        sources = [n for n in names if n.startswith('src/')]
        assert all(n == 'src/hackathon_toolkit/__init__.py' or n.startswith('src/hackathon_toolkit/rfq/') for n in sources)
        assert len(sources) == 9, sources
        print(f'Submission archive: {len(sources)} RFQ/package Python files; {archive.stat().st_size:,} bytes')
with zipfile.ZipFile('/tmp/ehl-rfq-cleanup-wheels/hackathon_toolkit-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl') as wheel:
    names = wheel.namelist()
    sources = [n for n in names if n.endswith('.py')]
    assert all(n == 'hackathon_toolkit/__init__.py' or n.startswith('hackathon_toolkit/rfq/') for n in sources)
    assert len(sources) == 9, sources
    metadata = wheel.read('hackathon_toolkit-0.1.0.dist-info/METADATA').decode()
    assert 'Provides-Extra: rfq' in metadata and 'Provides-Extra: test' in metadata
    assert metadata.count('Provides-Extra:') == 2
    print('Wheel: only RFQ source; only rfq and test dependency extras')
PY
 git diff --stat
 git diff --check",max_output_tokens:2300}));

content.text:
Removed 44 unused legacy files: extraction/RAG pipelines, Typesense, API server, simulations, demos, and associated tests/docs. Removed their dependency extras and restricted packaging to RFQ code.

Preserved the other agent’s changes. Their modified `config.py` remains locally but is excluded from packages.

Verified: **85 tests passed**, one optional browser test skipped; wheel build and archive checks passed.
